meta.title: Shande Villa — Street photography in Guangzhou
meta.description: Street photographer in China since 2008. My photos, my links (Instagram, Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Substack) and how to reach me for brand collaborations.
portada.bio: In China since 2008. I photograph what may not exist ten years from now.
contacto.texto: If you have a brand and want to work with me, send me a direct message on Instagram with your idea and your deadlines. I answer every message myself.
footer.texto: All photos are mine. If you'd like to use one, please ask me first.
